items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: we was in there recording... Andy Razaf come in with this music under his arm... So we recorded it, and Andy did the vocal on it, too.

ctx.x: Well, you went in the studio with the Russell band...

Yeah, we was in there recording, making another recording, and Andy Razaf come in with this music under his arm, and passed it out to Russell, and asked him would he record it for him, and naturally, Russell says yes. And he passed out the music, and just taken us unawares, you know what I mean?
Yeah. This was actually on the 19th of May, 1930, in New York.
